No rig of any kind: spec v2 line 5 is withdrawn by Sami's 2026-09-13 standing order.
review: legion-worker: one review per round via `legion gh -- api .../reviews`, threads answered `Accepted:`/`Still open:`; envoy: check the three exception reasons and the `dedupe_key` rule against the parent contract (dispatch://LEGION-101/spec, Design) — it is fixed with LEGION-107 and LEGION-109 and not renegotiable.

concerns: Spec v2 withdraws acceptance line 5 (no smoke rigs, scratch daemons, throwaway NATS containers, scratch tmux servers; e2e-local.sh included). The architect's assignment asked for a rig plan; the spec is the record, so this plan has no rig. The evidence the rig would have produced — the listener log line naming receipt_timeout and the captured exception envelope — comes from `go test -v` (the receipt_timeout test t.Logf's both) and is quoted on the PR.

No Go toolchain on this box (`which go` empty, `mise ls go` empty; go.mod says `go 1.26.1`, CI uses setup-go with go-version-file). The plan runs the gates through `mise x go@1.26 -- go ...`, which installs Go into mise's box-wide tool store (~/.local/share/mise/installs/go), not into ~/.omp/profiles/legion or legion.yaml. The operator rule forbids `mise install` against the live profile; this is a compiler in the tool store, but the architect should get the operator's OK. If refused, CI (`envoy-go` job in .github/workflows/envoy-and-contracts.yaml) is the only gate and the implementer says so in its handoff.

The listener package tests start a `nats:2.10` Docker testcontainer (`sharedListenerTestNATSURI`, main_test.go:35). The spec's Design sentence 'with no NATS container started' is inaccurate for the existing suite; this is `go test`, the same thing CI runs, not a rig. Docker 29.7.2 is present and the legion user is in the docker group. If it fails locally with a credential-helper error, docs/solutions/testing/testcontainers-go-resolves-all-docker-credhelpers.md is the fix.

Files beyond the assignment's list, each forced by an acceptance line: packages/envoy/internal/logging/logging.go gains NewWithWriter (line 1 asserts the log line; the logger hardcodes os.Stderr); cmd/listener/delivery.go's config gains a `forwardRole` func field wired in cmd/listener/main.go (line 2's 'publish fails' branch cannot be reached through the concrete *bus.Client — a closed connection or oversize payload also kills the exception publish); docs/solutions/architecture-patterns/core-nats-receipt-backed-current-holder-delivery.md says a two-second timeout is delivery_failed, which this change makes false.

Not touched on purpose: skills/envoy/SKILL.md ('Legion exception lane') names two reasons. Any `skills/**` change cuts a pi-envoy plugin release (release.yaml path filter), which would collide with LEGION-109's plugin release. Fold the one-sentence update into LEGION-109's PR or a fast-follow.

Metrics: the receipt_timeout outcome records `delivery_status="receipt_timeout"` on messages_delivered (new additive label value; nothing enumerates the values — checked cmd/listener/main.go, deploy/, internal/metrics/). Slow holders stop counting as `failed`, which is the point.

`validateMessageBody` is shared by /v1/messages/send, so a send body carrying both dedupe_key and idempotency_key now also answers 400 naming both; the send handler's code and its dedupe key (`agent.<target>.<idempotency|id>`) are unchanged and a lone dedupe_key on send is ignored as before. Nothing publishes to send with dedupe_key today (LEGION-107 uses publish).
summary: Two Go changes in packages/envoy/cmd/listener. (1) roleTopicDelivery: when the forward to a registered, live holder returns nats.ErrTimeout, the exception reason is receipt_timeout (log 'listener role receipt timed out'); every other forward error stays delivery_failed; both clear the attempt cache. (2) POST /v1/messages/publish accepts dedupe_key, used verbatim as the envelope dedupe key, mutually exclusive with idempotency_key (400 naming both). Proof is the listener package's Go tests (Docker NATS testcontainer) plus CI; no rig.

spec.parentContract: dispatch://LEGION-101/spec, section Design — shared with LEGION-107 (daemon) and LEGION-109 (plugin), not renegotiable

exceptionReasons.delivery_failed: a claim exists but the message was not forwarded: holder lookup failed, expired-claim cleanup failed, holder stale/not live, or the forward request itself errored with anything other than nats.ErrTimeout (unchanged meaning)
exceptionReasons.receipt_timeout: NEW: forwarded to a registered, live holder; no empty receipt inside roleReceiptTimeout (2s); RequestCoreTo returned nats.ErrTimeout

contract.exceptionPayloadUnchanged: deliveryExceptionPayload keeps original_topic, event_id, reason, payload_summary, payload, dedupe_key, source, source_session; the exception envelope's source_event_id is the original event_id.
contract.attemptCache: clearAttempt: true for delivery_failed and receipt_timeout; recordDedupe only on a delivered forward — so a re-publish with the same dedupe_key after receipt_timeout is forwarded again, after a delivered forward it is a dedupe skip.
contract.publishDedupeKey: body.dedupe_key non-empty -> envelope.dedupe_key = body.dedupe_key verbatim (no trimming; contracts.Envelope.Validate already 400s a whitespace-only key as 'dedupe_key is required'); empty string -> absent; idempotency_key alone -> 'publish.' + idempotency_key (unchanged); neither -> 'publish.' + id.New() (unchanged); both -> 400 {error: 'dedupe_key and idempotency_key are mutually exclusive', expected: ['dedupe_key','idempotency_key']}, nothing published.
contract.logLine: listener role receipt timed out — slog.LevelWarn via logger.DeliveryLog with delivery_status 'receipt_timeout', attrs session_id/topic/event_id, plus slog.String('timeout', roleReceiptTimeout.String()). Warn, not Error: a live holder that is slow is not a failure.
contract.notChanged: packages/contracts, internal/contracts/generated.go (reasons are not enumerated anywhere — checked), the send handler's code, roleReceiptTimeout, the exceptions-topic shape.

tasks.title: Docs: three reasons and the dedupe_key field
steps: packages/envoy/AGENTS.md line 90: replace 'no receipt within two seconds is `delivery_failed` and emits an exception.' with 'No receipt within two seconds from a registered, live holder is `receipt_timeout` (the message was forwarded and not acknowledged; the Legion daemon treats it as delivered to a live process); `delivery_failed` is a claim whose message was never forwarded (holder lookup failed, holder stale, or the forward request errored); `no_holder` is no claim at all. Every reason emits an exception and clears the attempt cache; the dedupe cache records a forward only when its receipt arrived, so a publish that re-uses a `dedupe_key` after a `receipt_timeout` is forwarded again, while one after a delivered forward is skipped.'
packages/envoy/AGENTS.md line 92: after '`reason`' insert ' (one of `no_holder`, `delivery_failed`, `receipt_timeout`)'.

packages/envoy/AGENTS.md line 113 (publish row): replace the Contract cell with 'Publishes a non-agent topic. An optional `dedupe_key` is used verbatim as the envelope's dedupe key (how a re-sent copy stays recognisable to the receiver's own dedupe); it is mutually exclusive with `idempotency_key` — both present is a 400 whose `expected` names both fields — and an empty string is absent; without either the key is minted. A `notifications.role.<role>` topic requires a live holder and returns that session ID in `holder`.'

packages/envoy/AGENTS.md line 124: change the first sentence to '`send` and `publish` accept optional `in_reply_to`, `supersedes`, `urgency`, `expects_reply`, and `expires_at`, and `publish` additionally `dedupe_key`; empty optional fields are omitted.'

docs/solutions/architecture-patterns/core-nats-receipt-backed-current-holder-delivery.md line 35: replace 'A two-second request timeout, a missing receiver, or a receiver that fails before replying is `delivery_failed`; publish the original envelope on the exception lane. An absent role claim is instead `no_holder`.' with 'A two-second request timeout from a registered, live receiver is `receipt_timeout` (LEGION-108: the receiver has the envelope and has not acknowledged it — a slow holder, not a lost message); a missing receiver, a stale registration, or a request that could not be sent is `delivery_failed`; an absent role claim is `no_holder`. Every reason publishes the original envelope on the exception lane.' Line 107: replace 'observable as `delivery_failed`' with 'observable as `receipt_timeout` (fresh but deaf) and `delivery_failed` (stopped)'.

Read both files once more against the code (reasons, field names, the 400 shape).
